messages:
Maya: Heads-up — Atlas Labs usage jumped this week. We hit 88% of soft quota yesterday and 102% of hard limit during a sustained batch job at 02:10 UTC. Recommend a short quota bump + proactive comms.
Aj: can you drop the numbers? % overage, tokens/day, and expected burn if they keep this pace?
Maya: Quick snapshot: peak QPS +45% week-over-week. avg tokens/day 1.2M (committed 1.0M). hard limit hit = 1.05M in a 1-hr window. projected 30d burn if constant = ~36M tokens.
Ben: any latency/error spikes correlated with the hard limit? want to know SRE/eng impact before we approve bump.
Maya: No consistent latency regression in the last 24h. We saw a few 5xxs during the hard limit spike; looks like graceful fallback kicked in. Logs: ```ERROR 2026-03-18T02:10:23Z model-backpressure: kv-cache miss -> 503 for request id 882b```
Sarah: If we bump, can the customer-facing banner include guidance to stagger batch jobs? We should also offer a short runbook.
Aj: Bump request: +25% quota for 72 hours, monitor, then auto-scale back. Need billing ok? cc @Ben for billing impact.
Ben: billing note — +25% for 72h is negligible for monthly invoice but may affect renewal talking points. Approve for canary 72h if CS handles comms and we log the change for audit.
Maya: Draft message for Atlas contacts — please critique: ```Hi Atlas team — quick heads up: we've observed a temporary surge in usage in your account which caused a short limit hit overnight. We've scheduled a 25% temporary quota increase for the next 72 hours to avoid interruptions. Please stagger large batch jobs if possible; we can help with a short runbook. We'll monitor and follow up with metrics. —Maya (Redwood CS)```
Sarah: Suggest adding SLA note: "no change to uptime SLA. This is a capacity smoothing measure." Also add contact for urgent help (oncall link).
Aj: Agree. Also add one-line internal broadcast for EngOps & Billing: ```Atlas Labs — temporary +25% quota from Tue 10:00 UTC -> Fri 10:00 UTC. CS owning customer comms. Monitor: /dash/atlas-usage.```
Maya: I'll post the customer banner and send the email Tue 10:00 UTC after we get Ben's final go-ahead. I'll also create a small alert (pager muted) to watch 5xx rate and avg latency.
Ben: Go-ahead from my side. Please tag me on the audit entry and include cost delta estimate.
Maya: Will do. Follow-ups: 1) banner + email Tue 10:00 UTC; 2) 72h bump; 3) post-mortem note if we re-hit hard limit. Ping me if you want to edit the draft. :thumbsup:
DeployBot: Automation scheduled: quota-change atlas-labs +25% at 2026-03-23T10:00:00Z, revert at 2026-03-26T10:00:00Z. Job id: jq-9074.
